item.description:
Board reconnects a resumed session; browser recovers from a page crash

  • Resuming a Claude session in a new tab reconnects it to the card that already has that session. If the card is in Trash, it comes back automatically with its links and column, instead of a new duplicate card.
  • The built-in browser reloads a page after its page process crashes. Before, a crashed Google Meet call stayed silent until a manual reload.
  • Tab mute and sound start/stop are now logged for diagnosis.
  • Limit: cards made before this build have no stored session, so they cannot be reconnected. Only Claude sessions are matched (not Codex or Cursor).
